title: Lake Keowee original parcel criteria and scenario source profile

source.title: Watershed-Based Plan for the Little River-Lake Keowee and Keowee River-Lake Keowee Watersheds
source.author: Lake Keowee Source Water Protection Team
source.prepared_for: South Carolina Department of Health and Environmental Control
source.retrieval: Primary-source page-specific search index, including structured tables.
source.page_numbering: Printed page numbers. Appendix D footers say 'of 173'; Appendix E footers say 'of 172'. Physical PDF page indexes are not assigned.

watersheds.name: Keowee River–Lake Keowee
watersheds.coverage: Mainly Pickens County SC; extends into North Carolina

semantics.aggregation: Sum criterion points using published category group caps. Point allocations are the weights.
semantics.missing: Unknown is retained as possible scores; it is not replaced by zero.
semantics.published_bin_overlap: Return all matching classes. A retained original parcel class can resolve ambiguity.
semantics.unmatched_numeric_value: Unclassified under the literal published bins. An explicit adaptation may supply a continuous or rounded interpretation.
semantics.cwa: Furman University 2017 InVEST-derived Critical Watershed Area raster. Larger parcel means indicate larger potential harm if developed; class ranges use geometric intervals. A reproducible CWA formula is not printed.
semantics.current_export: Parcel mean of per-pixel annual current export from the original Furman InVEST rasters. Preserve raster identity, pixel area, units and grid. A parcel total and a scenario difference are different quantities.
semantics.sediment_ton_definition: Not explicit in the printed export-bin table; retain native source unit before conversion.
semantics.spatial_operations: Supply actual polygon intersections, adjacency and hydrologic upstream relationships. Record source CRS and analysis CRS; point monitoring locations do not provide parcel masks.
semantics.scenario_transfer: Outside the two original HUC10s, retain this original profile and record an explicit adaptation with target geography, replacement inputs and chosen bins.
semantics.native_parameters: Priority points and category totals are not NDR or SDR model calibration parameters.

observation_contract.original_fields: Canonical analysis names are an adapter layer. Original provider field keys and values stay intact.
observation_contract.raster_binding: Record baseline run id, output layer id, grid id, pixel area and source units for each zonal mean.

rules.multi_home_year: Use the oldest residence year on the parcel.
rules.later_years: Retain years after 2019 and define an explicit updated cohort.
rules.high_medium_method: Page 158 says ages near waterways were grouped by mean; the exact soil-by-age matrix and high/medium numeric cutoff are not printed. Return the source dimensions separately or retain original GIS priority.

septic.meaning: Residence age and proximity are survey-targeting assumptions. Preserve actual sewer-service records and observed system condition as separate fields.

agricultural_bundle_bacteria.time_basis: Per-project average derived from completed 2012 Section 319 projects; confirm original report time basis before annualizing.

reference.detail: Appendix A reproduction of Shaver et al. 2007

landcover_coefficients.mixing: Multiply each cover coefficient by that cover's actual area and sum. Use area fractions for a mean coefficient.
landcover_coefficients.role: Cited screening comparison with explicit units; native InVEST outputs retain their own model lineage.

source_discrepancies.detail: Table 31 awards first or second order streams; Appendix D awards first order only.
source_discrepancies.response: Preserve both outcomes for second-order-only parcels unless a source interpretation is selected.

source_discrepancies.detail: The low upper bound 0.032488 exceeds the medium lower bound 0.0324489.
source_discrepancies.response: Keep both printed ranges and all matching scores; an original class label can resolve them.

source_discrepancies.detail: Some printed class boundaries leave small gaps.
source_discrepancies.response: Record any rounding or continuous-threshold interpretation as an adaptation.

source_discrepancies.detail: The 0.013-mile mean is expressly attributed to Three and Twenty Creek.
source_discrepancies.response: Retain that source label; an adapted evaluation can use the measured target-cohort mean.
Retain the year and class gap.

source_discrepancies.detail: High and medium maps are provided without a numeric cutoff or reproducible soil-by-age matrix.
source_discrepancies.response: Return observed distance, age and soil dimensions, or retain original GIS priority.

source_discrepancies.detail: $190.85 plus $213.85 equals $404.70; the table total is $404.71.
source_discrepancies.response: Retain published and component-derived totals separately.

source_discrepancies.detail: Page 43 prose gives $303.53/acre; tables and project totals use $404.71/acre.
source_discrepancies.response: Use the table rate in the catalog and preserve the alternate source figure.

source_discrepancies.detail: Page 132 has 1,868 feet and two watering facilities; page 133 has 1,686 feet and one facility.
source_discrepancies.response: Retain both variants; itemized and published package estimates have different definitions.

source_discrepancies.detail: Appendix A coefficients are kg/ha/year; page 130 conversion prose and chapter 37 land-protection totals use inconsistent stated factors or units.
source_discrepancies.response: Use explicit dimensional conversion for an adapted calculation; preserve original totals as source values.

source_discrepancies.detail: The recipe names a 35-metre buffer on page 135 and a 35-foot minimum on page 136.
source_discrepancies.response: Keep both variants and record selected model-input units.

source_discrepancies.detail: The plan uses TGPT; the SCDES source field H2OCLASS uses TPGT for the corresponding trout class.
source_discrepancies.response: Apply the named scdes-h2oclass-to-keowee-2020 adapter and retain original H2OCLASS values. The current original inventory contains 599 TPGT features.

provider_adaptations.title: SCDES stream class codes to Lake Keowee printed classes
provider_adaptations.source_scope: Use complete observed parcel-intersected stream classes. The retained selected-class inventory covers special classes; FW coverage is supplied by its original class source.
provider_adaptations.interpretation: The plan spells its three-point trout class TGPT (Trout Waters Grow Put Take); the current publisher code is TPGT. This named adapter preserves the original source value while applying the plan's stated class.
